meta.identity: ESPN athlete id -> (nflverse approved id columns) -> Pro-Football-Reference id -> Wikidata QID, or ESPN athlete id -> Wikidata QID directly. Strong identifiers only; a name is never a join. Where two strong ids disagree the player is recorded ambiguous and gets no section.

sampling_bias.meaning: Absence is not evidence. This layer is built from Wikidata items, which exist for people notable enough to have one, so a missing college record means we have not resolved it — never that the player did not play college football.

not_included: any CollegeFootballData field (CFBD ingestion is disabled)
